text:
Vera (Marketing): Quick sync — final prep for Thu's micro-webinar. Need: confirm one-liner topic, who handles lead flags, and the golden fallback if live demo hiccups. Short replies please.

Ibrahim (Producer): Proposed runtime (PT):
- 17:40 green room open
- 17:50 mic checks (host + speaker)
- 18:00 doors open
- 18:03 host intro (90s)
- 18:05 demo (15m)
- 18:20 mini-panel (8m)
- 18:28 live Q + lead triage (10m)
- 18:38 CTA + wrap.

Sophie (Host): For topic line I'm thinking: "3 practical inference knobs that lower cost without changing UX" — punchy and concrete. Also will read fallback line if demo slow: "Well switch to the short demo clip and follow up with the config guide in docs."

Rex (Speaker): That topic works. Ill compress demo to 12m and keep a 3-slide cheat-sheet for the panel. Uploading slides v1 tonight. Mic/cam: ✅.

Lina (Growth): I'll triage leads. Please add me to the private lead channel #wb-3001-leads. I'll mark MQLs and drop quick notes. Also ask: can we include a promo code for attendees? small incentive for trials.

Vera (Marketing): Promo code OK. I'll bake a short CTA slide and a 10% trial coupon. Created #wb-3001-leads and invited Lina + Rex + OpsBot.

Ibrahim (Producer): On-call infra: pinging eng-runtime-oncall for standby. OpsBot will also prepare a fallback asset. OpsBot: schedule green room reminder 20m prior.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Green room opens in 20m" -> 3001113322. Fallback asset generated: assets/fallbacks/alt-demo-90s.mp4.

eng-runtime-oncall: Standby confirmed (17:45-19:00 PT). Will monitor latency and key metrics. If token latency >8s, advise cut to fallback.

Sophie (Host): Who reads audience Qs aloud? I can do it but need a feed of top 3 signal Qs. Lina, can you feed me highest-signal ones in the private channel?

Lina (Growth): Yup — will pin top Qs and DM you 1-2 picks during the show. Also will flag any demo interest to #wb-3001-leads.

Rex (Speaker): Rehearsal plan (short):
```
17:40 join green room (host+producer+speaker+oncall)
17:50 mic-checks + slides pass
17:55 run handoff (host -> demo -> panel)
18:00 final mute/unmute sweep
```

Ibrahim (Producer): Please freeze slides Wed 6pm PT. Also enable captions and recording. Anyone need captions turned off?

Vera (Marketing): Captions ON. Recording ON. Freeze acknowledged.

Rex (Speaker): Quick ask: include a single slide with the exact snippet for the lightweight config so people can screenshot. I'll add it slide 7.

Sophie (Host): Good call. Also adding a 1-sentence fallback script to my notes: "If youre seeing slow responses, check the lightweight config in the docs and well email the snippet after the session."

Lina (Growth): Also please add a one-click survey link in the chat post-session so we can capture intent. I'll prep the form and post it.

Ibrahim (Producer): Final ops checklist: 1) slides by Wed 6pm PT, 2) eng-runtime oncall confirmed, 3) fallback asset available, 4) private lead channel active, 5) captions+recording on. If all agree, this is good to go.

Vera (Marketing): All good from marketing. Lina will own lead flags. Sophie will read top Qs. Rex will upload slides tonight. Thanks team 44d

Rex (Speaker): :thumbsup: slides uploaded (v1). I'll be in green room 17:30 for an extra pass.

eng-runtime-oncall: I'll post a brief health-check at 17:55 in the ops thread.

Ibrahim (Producer): StageBot: scheduled: "Green room opens in 20m" -> 3001113322. Closing thread 4cc

Sophie (Host): See you all then.
